weapons.name: Beebeegun
weapons.status: Default (Level 1) [Fan-wiki]. One of the original three BBR primaries: the page's first revision (2012-02-03) lists BeebeeGun, Electric Honey and Zombee Gun [Fan-wiki]. Rebalanced in BBG v2.6 (Dec 20, 2013) [Fan-wiki]. In BB Heroes (soft launch May 2023), 'Beebee Gun' is Riggs's attack [Fan-wiki], and SkyVu names it [Canon]. Not seen in the 2026 trailer or the Steam screenshots [Unverified for 2026].
weapons.official_text: "Artificially accelerated and naturally angry bees. Also the bees are fired backwards. And their stingers are infused with adamantium." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Beebeegun . BBH era: "Wielding his "Beebee gun," he excels in close combat, delivering a burst of shells that unleash severe damage when focused on a single target, proving lethal at short distances." [Canon] https://battlebears.com/pages/characters
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: automatic minigun with wind-up and wind-down delays. It is hitscan, since the wiki says automatics 'use hitscans'. 5.5 damage, 0.1 s rate, 100 ammo, 4 s reload, dispersion 0.08, +10% Health modifier [Fan-wiki]. No splash or status effect [Fan-wiki]. Cosmetic: 'small bees circling its hive' [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Photo_19-04-13_12_50_44_PM.png, 2013 gear-up; File:Beebee.png, BBR 2012 gear-up]: a long black boxy minigun held low at the hip, with yellow and orange striped glowing panels and a golden-yellow beehive dome on top. CONCEPT [Observed File:Beebeegun_original_concept.jpg]: grey sketch labelled 'Riggs: Plasma Globe Glob Launcher', a three-barrel gun topped by a plasma globe. The wiki says the BBR lineup art is a hybrid of the Beebeegun and Plasma Orb [Fan-wiki]. In that art [Observed File:Heavy.jpg] Riggs wears a blue bandana and green pack and holds a black triple-barrel minigun with yellow accents and a pink plasma globe. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: no image or video of it firing was found [Unverified]. The text says bees fired backwards [Game text via wiki], while BBH text says 'burst of shells' [Canon]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: barrels whir up, then a stream of tiny yellow-black bees flies tail-first as tracer streaks, with small sting-puffs on the target and no explosion [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Provolowned
weapons.status: Unlock for 50 Gas, Level 1 [Fan-wiki]. Released in the first week of BBR v1.3.1 (June 28, 2012; that update rolled out over four weeks). Forum Appreciation members got it free and early [Fan-wiki]. It originally cost 120,000 Joules and became 100 Gas in BBR 1.4.2 (Feb 28, 2013) [Fan-wiki]. Nerfed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "The list of dangers associated with over consumption of cheese just got a little bit longer. Four cheese blend your opponents into a quivering mass of curdled shame!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Provolowned
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: automatic minigun, a 're-texture of the Beebeegun', with a notably long wind-up [Fan-wiki]. Hitscan. 7.5 damage, 0.126 cooldown, 100 ammo, 5 s reload, dispersion 0.08 [Fan-wiki]. Cosmetic: 'small flies circling its circular cheese' [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Provolowned.png, a render carrying the BATTLE BEARS logo]: the body is a pale-yellow cheese block with holes and red specks, tied with twine, with orange crust-like stick parts. A white wedge sits on top. The barrel is a silver box-grater-like block with rows of round holes. In-hand view [Observed File:Gnifle-heavy-setup.png]: Riggs in a wolf skin holds it at the hip. Also shown in the 1.3.1 promo [Observed File:BBRWEAPONS.png]. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: none documented [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a spray of grated-cheese flecks that leaves the target cheese-splattered, kept non-gory [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Field Medic
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, Level 1 [Fan-wiki]. Released in the fourth and final week of BBR v1.3.1 (July 2012) [Fan-wiki]. Its 8% health reduction was removed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "You ever wonder where the military stores all of its amputated limbs? Wonder no longer! Covering your head and fleeing is probably the best thing to do now." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Field_Medic
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: automatic; it 'fires a continuous stream of amputated limbs' [Fan-wiki]. It is a 'retexture of the Zombee Gun' [Fan-wiki]. 6.4 damage, 0.1 s rate, 40 ammo, 3.5 s reload, 850-unit range, -10% Health, +20% Speed [Fan-wiki]. Conflict: the v2.6 page lists changes (damage 19 to 15, cooldown 0.4 to 2) that do not fit an automatic [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Photo_19-04-13_12_50_38_PM.png]: a tan, cardboard-brown boxy minigun with a dark six-hole rotary muzzle. A blue grinning Huggable in an olive army helmet pops out of the top, and white sparkle stars glint near the muzzle. It also appears in the 1.3.1 promo [Observed File:BBRWEAPONS.png]. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: cartoon plush limbs (stuffed arms and legs, no blood) bouncing off the target [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Big Iron
weapons.status: Unlock for 60,000 Joules, Level 15 [Fan-wiki]. Released in BBR v1.3.2 (Aug 24, 2012), whose update text reads 'New weapons for Soldier and Heavy classes' [Fan-wiki quoting update notes]. The official-looking promo File:Update_1_3_2_coming_soon.jpeg says 'New Weapons: Soldier & Heavy Classes' [Observed]. It was designed as a secondary and swapped with Mother of Nature during testing [Fan-wiki]. Changed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "That's a big gun you have there pardner." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Big_Iron
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: semi-automatic hand cannon. It is listed as 'Explosives*' but has no AoE, so it needs direct hits with a fast projectile (2,000 u/s). 50 damage, 0.5 s rate, 6 ammo, 3 s reload [Fan-wiki]. Bug: at close range shots may deal no damage [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Big_iron_poster.png; File:Big_Iron.jpg]: an oversized gunmetal-grey revolver with tally-notch scratches on the barrel and a dark red wooden grip; Riggs holds it two-handed at chest height. The wiki links the notches to Billy the Kid and Marty Robbins' song 'Big Iron' [Fan-wiki]. It also appears in the 1.3.2 promo [Observed File:1.3.2WEAPONS.png]. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: none documented [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: one heavy muzzle flash, a fast streak, and the target knocked back with no explosion [BBG News invention].
image_leads: (File:Big_Iron_hacker.jpg shows a non-Riggs armoured character; do not use)

weapons.name: Electric Honey
weapons.status: Unlock for 10,000 Joules, Level 2 [Fan-wiki]. One of the original three BBR primaries [Fan-wiki]. Its price rose from 8,000 to 10,000 Joules in BBR 1.4.2 (Feb 28, 2013) [Fan-wiki]. Nerfed in v2.6, with conflicting accounts: the trivia says 140 to 120 ammo, the 2.6 page says 120 to 50 [Fan-wiki]. 2026: present in the official Steam trailer and screenshot, used by Riggs in the Rocky Horror skin [Observed]. BBO era: 'Electric Honey (BBO)' carried over as a launch-day reward for linked BBG accounts and was later sold [Fan-wiki].
weapons.official_text: "Electrically charged bees are slightly smaller* allowing for a higher bees-per-hive ratio and thus longer continuous fire!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Electric_Honey_(BBG)
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: automatic minigun with a moderate wind-up; hitscan. 5.5 damage, 0.10 s rate, 120 ammo, 3 s reload, dispersion 0.06 [Fan-wiki]. Cosmetic: 'small bees circling its hive as well as purple energy rings on the hive and barrel' [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Photo_19-04-13_12_50_47_PM.png; File:Electric_Honey.png (2012); File:Heavy_setup.jpg; File:Theincredibleriggs.jpg; Steam screenshot ss_487a600c... (= visuals/steam_screens/screen_00.jpg)]: a black boxy minigun with purple glowing slatted panels. On top sits a pink-and-magenta striped hive with two small pink ball-tipped antennae, and purple/magenta striped coil 'wings' trail behind it. Translucent magenta energy rings spiral around the barrel. FIRING AND IMPACT [Observed trailer.mp4 ~34.5-36.3 s, frames dl/riggs/trhi/r_006-r_015, sheet dl/riggs/sheets/J_eh_fire.jpg; also screen_00.jpg]: the magenta rings pulse at the muzzle and a thin dark tracer streak runs to the target. On hit, a pink-magenta starburst of shard-like sparks appears and the target briefly flashes lighter. Individual bees cannot be seen at trailer resolution [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: tiny purple 'electric bees' as tracer streaks with small crackles, plus a magenta spark burst on impact [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Zombee Gun
weapons.status: Unlock for 100,000 Joules, Level 12 (originally 80,000 Joules) [Fan-wiki]. One of the original three BBR primaries [Fan-wiki]. Changed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]. It appears in the official 2014 'Riggs Overhaul' video thumbnail [Observed]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Most of the damage this weapon deals is psychological." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Zombee_Gun
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: automatic; a 'continuous stream of what appears to be ground-up zombie Huggables' [Fan-wiki]. An anonymous 2012 first revision says it 'fires bones and green liquid' and that the liquid wobbles [Fan-wiki, early]. 4.5 damage, 0.1 s rate, 300 ammo, 4 s reload, 1,000-unit range, +15% Speed, -7.5% Health [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Photo_19-04-13_12_50_49_PM.png; File:Zombee.png (2012); SkyVu thumbnail https://i.ytimg.com/vi/xp5B76ExuAI/hq1.jpg]: a blood-red and black mottled boxy gun with a round ribbed muzzle. A bright-green grinning Huggable (antennae, big teeth) sticks out of the top. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: green slime blobs and cartoon bone bits that splat on the target [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Bounce Lazer
weapons.status: Unlock for 50 Gas, Level 15 [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG v2.19 (Apr 26, 2015) [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Turn this place into a rave! Bounce your lasers off of everything!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Bounce_Lazer
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: 'fires a beam of rainbows similar to the Huggable (Class) Headlights' that ricochets off walls. The page conflicts on bounces: 10 in Usage, 25 in Trivia [Fan-wiki]. 40 damage per second, rate 0.2, 32 ammo, 4 s reload, 1,250-unit range, +10% Speed [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Bounce_lazer.jpg]: a slate-blue boxy blaster with a small round muzzle, green and orange indicator lights and a rainbow-gradient strip. A dead pink Huggable head (X eyes, open grin, tongue out) is mounted at its base. Reading the head as the power source fits the BB-1 cutscene line 'A huggable's rainbow soul can power a laser gun!' [Inference]. BEAM/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a rainbow beam zig-zagging off walls with a sparkle at each bounce [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Flame Thrower
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG v2.14 (Nov 29, 2014) [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Burn your enemies with the power of hot morning coffee without the lawsuit!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Flame_Thrower
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: short-to-mid-range stream; 'it will shoot red-colored flames', similar to Cosmic Fire [Fan-wiki]. 12 damage, 0.125 rate, 40 ammo, 4 s reload, +20% Speed, -10% Health [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Flamethrower_.jpg]: a red rectangular can with a flame logo on its label, mounted on a black zig-zag-ribbed hexagonal barrel, with a silver segmented grip. Reading the can as the 'hot morning coffee' can is [Inference]. LINEAGE: the wiki says it references Oliver's homemade flamethrower in BB Zombies [Fan-wiki]. That BB Zombies weapon card [Observed File:FlameThrower.png] shows Oliver with a red can and a grater-like nozzle spraying orange fire and black smoke. BBG FLAME/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a red-orange flame cone that leaves the target singed and smoking, no gore [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Hivey League
weapons.status: Default [Fan-wiki]. An original BBR secondary [Fan-wiki]. BBR 1.3 (May 3, 2012) update text: 'Improved Spreadshot and Hivey League behavior' [Fan-wiki quoting update notes]. Its speed penalty went from -15% to -5% and was then removed in v2.6 (Dec 20, 2013) [Fan-wiki]. The 2012 gear screen shows 'SPEED -15%' [Observed File:Hivey_league.png]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Fires a spreading cone of angry bees! Great for close range battles with multiple targets close together." [Game text via wiki; labelled 'BBR Description' in the page's first revision, 2012-10-20] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Hivey_League
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: shotgun, a short-range hitscan cone [Fan-wiki]. The stats conflict: damage is printed as '1525' (probably 15-25), the infobox says 4 ammo while the text says six bullets, 0.75 s rate, 6 s reload [Fan-wiki]. Trivia: 'Honey seems to drip out on the barrel' [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Heavy.png (blue-team Riggs); File:Hivey_league.png (2012); File:Heavy_Class.jpg]: a golden-yellow hexagonal beehive with a bee emblem sits on a white-grey boxy body with an orange stripe. The muzzle is a block of hexagonal honeycomb holes with yellow inside. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a fan-shaped burst of angry bees with honey droplets, and the target swatting at stings [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Plasma Orb
weapons.status: Unlock for 60 Gas, no level [Fan-wiki]. Released in BBR v1.3.1 (June 28, 2012) [Fan-wiki]. It cost 150,000 Joules, then 100 Gas from BBR 1.4.2 (Feb 28, 2013), then 60 Gas [Fan-wiki]. Its -10% Health penalty was removed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]; the 2012 gear screen shows 'HEALTH -10%' [Observed File:Plasma_orb.png]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "The amount of voltage this gun produces is just enough to turn anything it touches into a smoldering husk of its former self... is that enough you think?" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Plasma_Orb
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: shotgun, a 're-skin of the Hivey League'; it 'releases a spreading blast of purple electricity' [Fan-wiki]. 40 damage, 1.5 s rate, 2 ammo, 5 s reload [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Plasma_Orb.png render; File:Plasma_orb.png; File:ROcky_Horror.png]: a dark navy-black pistol-grip launcher. A dark plasma globe on top crackles with blue-violet lightning. The muzzle is a glowing magenta hexagon with vertical slats, with pink vents along the body and small blue sparkle sprites near the globe. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a short cone of forked purple lightning that leaves the target briefly smoking and soot-darkened [BBG News invention].
image_leads: (File:Plasma_Orb_hacker.png shows a non-Riggs character; do not use)

weapons.name: Mother of Nature
weapons.status: Unlock for 50,000 Joules, Level 20 [Fan-wiki]. Released in BBR v1.3.2 (Aug 24, 2012) [Fan-wiki]. Changed in v2.6. Its -10% Health penalty was removed in v2.7 and later re-implemented [Fan-wiki]; the 2012 gear screen shows 'HEALTH -10%' [Observed File:Mother_of_nature.png]. It is featured in SkyVu's own 2014 'Riggs Overhaul' thumbnails [Observed]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Shoots poisonous berries at your enemies that drain their health over time." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Mother_of_Nature
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: a lobbed projectile in an arc (750 u/s), described as a 'large purple berry'. On contact with any surface it 'will burst open, creating a large purple plume of poison' [Fan-wiki]. STATUS: Poisoned, 4 damage per second for 10 s (40 total). It stacks, can poison the user, and shows 'a small purple skull' over victims [Fan-wiki]. 2 ammo, 2.5 s rate, 6 s reload [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Photo_19-04-13_12_50_55_PM.png; File:Mother_Of_Nature.png; File:1.3.2WEAPONS.png]: a hollow, splintered wooden log or tree-trunk launcher bound with green vines, with purple veins and yellow-green moss. EFFECT [Observed SkyVu thumbnails https://i.ytimg.com/vi/xp5B76ExuAI/maxresdefault.jpg and /hq2.jpg]: Riggs aims the log at an enemy wrapped in a dark-purple smoke cloud. A large purple skull-shaped puff floats nearby, and the HUD ammo reads 1/2. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a purple berry arcs over, splats into a purple cloud with a skull silhouette, and the target coughs under a purple skull icon [BBG News invention, built on Observed and Fan-wiki].

weapons.name: Freeze Blast
weapons.status: Unlock, Level 1. The price conflicts: 150,000 Joules on the class page, 225,000 Joules in the weapon infobox [Fan-wiki]. Added in BBG v2.12 (Oct 2, 2014) [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Blastin you with FREEEZEEEEE!!!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Freeze_Blast
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: it 'fires small blue projectiles in an arc. On contact, these projectiles split and form damaging pools on the floor, similar to the Gernobyl. Enemies who step in the pools will be slowed down severely.' The page also says 'Direct hits do an insignificant amount of radiation damage' (sic) [Fan-wiki]. 5 damage, explosives 5-10, 0.5 s rate, 5 ammo, 4 s reload [Fan-wiki]. The Status Effects page gives 'Slowed' a yellow Z icon but does not list Freeze Blast, so the overhead icon is [Unverified]. LOOK [Observed File:Freeze.jpg]: a pale icy-cyan boxy launcher with a yellow-orange panel. Its long cylindrical barrel ends in a white three-pronged clamp muzzle with a black bore, and a small orange cap sits on top. PROJECTILE/IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: blue ice globs arc over and shatter into frosty floor puddles, and victims slow down, frosted [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Buzz Kill
weapons.status: Unlock for 25,000 Joules, Level 3 [Fan-wiki]. One of the original three BBR secondaries [Fan-wiki]. BBR 1.3 (May 3, 2012) update text: 'Improved Buzz Kill' [Fan-wiki quoting update notes]. Older stats: max explosives 50, rate 1.7 s, fly-off delay 2 s [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Fires a queen bee which explodes a second or two after impact." [Game text via wiki; labelled 'BBR Description' in the page's first revision, 2012-10-20] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Buzz_Kill
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: explosive. It shoots a 'large bee-like explosive' that sticks to surfaces and explodes 1.5 s after landing (the page also says two seconds), or at once on contact with an enemy [Fan-wiki]. Projectile speed 800; it 'flies with an upward arc instead of a downward one' [Fan-wiki]. Explosives 40-70 with AoE, 3 ammo, 1.5 s rate, 3.5 s reload [Fan-wiki]. The wiki calls it 'the Heavy's only weapon that causes an actual explosion' [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:BuzzKill.jpg; File:Buzz_kill.png (2012)]: a grey boxy gun with orange-yellow stripes and a gold hexagonal 'queen bee' capsule with a bee emblem on top. The muzzle is a black-and-yellow striped hexagon, and a white smoke puff hangs at it in the gear-up shot. EXPLOSION: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a fat golden queen bee flies out, sticks, buzzes and blinks for 1.5 s, then pops in a yellow-orange cartoon blast with a few dazed bees [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Sucker Punch
weapons.status: Unlock for 75,000 Joules, Level 14 [Fan-wiki]. An original BBR secondary: the Heavy page's first revision (Feb 2012) lists it [Fan-wiki]. Ammo went from 1 to 6 to 3. The overhead icon changed from a green question mark to a blue Nuggs [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Lobs a projectile that will stun the target for a few seconds." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Sucker_Punch . The page's first revision (anonymous, 2012-05-27) reads: "Stuns friend and foe the sucker punch launches a huggable head to stun suckers in its path!" [Fan-wiki; possibly an older in-game text, Unverified].
weapons.mechanics: FIRE: non-damaging saboteur. It lobs 'a small, pink Huggable-like head' in an arc at 1,000 u/s [Fan-wiki]. STATUS: Stunned for 2.6 s. A blue Nuggs appears over the victim's head; the victim cannot move, use weapons, reload or use Specials, but can look around [Fan-wiki]. The head stays intact after hitting and can physically push players, and it can get through the Iron Curtain [Fan-wiki]. 3 ammo, 3 s reload, +10% Speed [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:SuckerPunch.jpg]: a compact grey and tan boxy launcher with a pink smiling Huggable head mounted on the front (Riggs in the Rocky Horror skin). STUN ICON [Observed File:Images_(3).jpg, 259x194]: a round blue creature with a white swirl ring floats above a stunned player. POSSIBLE OFFICIAL SHOT [Observed https://i.ytimg.com/vi/xp5B76ExuAI/hq3.jpg]: the HUD weapon icon looks like a pink Huggable head on a grey hazard-striped box, the ammo reads 4/6, and the target is engulfed in a yellow-white burst. That this is the Sucker Punch, matching the old 6-ammo version, is [Inference]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a pink plush head bonks the target and bounces off, and the target freezes mid-pose with a spinning blue Nuggs [BBG News invention, built on Fan-wiki].

weapons.name: Barbed Gloves
weapons.status: Default; an original BBR melee [Fan-wiki]. Changed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Oven mitts for serving hot pain." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Barbed_Gloves
weapons.mechanics: MELEE: a two-glove punch, 70 damage, which the second glove can double. No stat modifiers [Fan-wiki]. The 2.6 page conflicts with that figure (35 to 20) [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Photo_19-04-13_12_51_16_PM.png; File:Barbed_gloves.png (2012)]: a pair of oversized yellow plush gloves shaped like round creatures with black dot eyes, wrapped in black barbed wire with red scratch and stitch marks. They are not 'dark brawler gloves' (see notes). IMPACT: no visual found [Unverified]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: a double haymaker that sends the target spinning with cartoon stars [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Catastrophe (in-game spelling: Catastophe)
weapons.status: Unlock for 20 Gas, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Released in the first week of BBR v1.3.1 (June 2012); Forum Appreciation members got it free and early [Fan-wiki]. BBR 1.4.2 removed -5% Health and added +5% Speed [Fan-wiki]. The 2012 gear screen shows 'HEALTH -5% SPEED +15%' [Observed File:Catastrophe.png]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Let Riggs bring the kitten cuddlin' to you! You may not like how he does it, though, and living through it isn't likely... but hey, kittens!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Catastrophe
weapons.mechanics: MELEE: a two-glove punch, 40 damage, doubled by the second glove. The text gives '20% speed reduction and a 10% health boost' but also calls it 'the only Heavy melee with both a positive speed and health stat modifier' [Fan-wiki internal conflict]. The in-game list spells it 'CATASTOPHE' [Observed File:Catastrophe.png; File:Heavy_setup.jpg]. LOOK [Observed File:Catastrophe_1.png]: each glove is a calico cat head (white, brown and orange patches) with one big glossy blue cartoon eye, a pink mouth or ear, and brown ear tips. It also appears in the 1.3.1 promo [Observed File:BBRWEAPONS.png]. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: cat-head gloves that hiss on impact [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Blood Spurt
weapons.status: Unlock for 60,000 Joules, no level lock [Fan-wiki]. Released in BBR v1.3.2 (Aug 24, 2012) [Fan-wiki]. BBR 1.4.2 removed its +15% Health [Fan-wiki]. Changed in v2.6 [Fan-wiki]. 2026: shown in the official Steam trailer [Observed].
weapons.official_text: "Bolo your enemies!" [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Blood_Spurt
weapons.mechanics: MELEE: a two-glove punch, 70 damage, doubled if both gloves connect. -10% Health, +10% Speed. It uses the same swing animation as the Heavy's other melees [Fan-wiki]. LOOK [Observed File:Blood_spurt.png; File:Blood_Spurt.jpg; File:1.3.2WEAPONS.png]: fists wrapped in tan bandage-tape with dark crack lines and pale-blue knuckle blocks, studded with green, gold and copper glass-like spikes. Reading the name as a nod to the film 'Bloodsport' and Bolo Yeung is [Inference]. 2026 [Observed trailer.mp4 ~36.7-38.1 s; frames dl/riggs/trhi/r_017-r_024; crops dl/riggs/crops/tr_r017_punch.png, tr_r020_card.png]: Riggs in the Rocky Horror skin lands a Blood Spurt punch on a golden-yellow bear. The 'RIGGS / HEAVY' title card freezes on that punch, with white light glints on the spikes and an orange round emblem with five holes behind the name. No blood is shown. DEPICTION FOR SHORTS: shard-glint punches with a crystalline sparkle on contact, no blood [BBG News invention].

weapons.name: Sword and Stone
weapons.status: Unlock, no level lock. The price conflicts: 150,000 Joules on the class page; the Updates page says v2.20 (May 29, 2015) cut it 'from 1,000,000 joules to 300,000 joules' [Fan-wiki]. 'Fully modeled and textured, first previewed back in 2012', then released in BBG v2.11 (Aug 27, 2014) [Fan-wiki]. 2026 status [Unverified].
weapons.official_text: "Riggs knew he wasn't the chosen one but dislike the idea of losing, so he took the stone with the sword." [Game text via wiki] https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Sword_and_Stone
weapons.mechanics: MELEE: 40 damage, doubled if both hits connect; -7.5% Health, +15% Speed [Fan-wiki]. notes:
CLASS: Riggs is the Heavy. Steam lists 'HEAVY: Riggs' [Canon] (https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=4408320). In-game class blurb: "Riggs the heavy is built like a tank, and moves like a stone. Keep clear of wide open spaces as his primary weapons have poor accuracy! Your melee attack is devastating!" [Game text via wiki] (Template:Class:Heavy_(BBG)). The complete BBG arsenal is 20 items: 8 primaries, 6 secondaries and 6 melees, from https://battlebears.fandom.com/wiki/Heavy_(BBG). The Heavy (BBG)/Weapons subpage is a stub listing only Provolowned and Electric Honey. Original BBR kit (first revision of the page, 2012-02-03): Beebeegun, Electric Honey, Zombee Gun / Hivey League, Buzz Kill, Sucker Punch / Barbed Gloves, Huggable Gloves, Zombee Gloves [Fan-wiki]. Additions: BBR 1.3.1 (Jun 28 2012) Provolowned, Field Medic, Plasma Orb, Catastrophe; BBR 1.3.2 (Aug 24 2012) Big Iron, Mother of Nature, Blood Spurt; BBG 2.11 (Aug 27 2014) Sword and Stone; 2.12 (Oct 2 2014) Freeze Blast; 2.14 (Nov 29 2014) Flame Thrower; 2.19 (Apr 26 2015) Bounce Lazer [Fan-wiki Updates page]. Steam 2026: '80+ PRIMARY WEAPONS 60+ SECONDARY WEAPONS 50+ MELEES' [Canon]; there is no official 2026 per-class list.

ERRORS IN weapons_by_class.json['Riggs']: A Salt Rifle, B.E.A.R. Club, Heavy A Salt Rifle, Krikkit Bat, Soaker, Spreadshot (BBG) and Steamshot are Soldier weapons. They leaked in because the Heavy page's 'BBR 1.0' changelog is copy-pasted Soldier data; it even lists Oliver skins and the Bearzooka. Catastrophe is missing because the class page links the misspelling 'Catastophe'; it sits in _unassigned. 'The Incredible Riggs' (in _unassigned) is a Heavy SKIN, 400,000 J, added in 2.15 (Dec 20 2014), wrongly placed in Category:BBG Weapons. Adrenaline Gun (Arbiter), ClubCobra (Combat Tech) and Hazard Toy (Assassin) are not Heavy weapons.

VISUAL LANGUAGE (for the visual researcher): Heavy guns are oversized boxy miniguns and launchers held at the hip. Most carry a themed 'topper': a beehive (Beebeegun, Hivey League, Buzz Kill, Electric Honey), cheese (Provolowned), a Huggable or Huggable head (Field Medic, Zombee Gun, Bounce Lazer, Sucker Punch), a plasma globe (Plasma Orb) or a vine-bound log (Mother of Nature) [Observed]. The bee and honey theme is [Inference]. In the 2013 gear-up shots, the default 3D Riggs is pale blue-grey with red segmented headgear, a red chest harness with a round red medallion ringed in yellow, red forearm and shin bands, and a red round backpack. File:Heavy.png and File:Heavy_Class.jpg show the same gear in blue [Observed]. That the colour is team colour is [Inference]. The 2026 trailer and Steam screenshot skin is 'Rocky Horror': red cracked-rock body, red eyes and a dark round back-shield. It matches File:ROcky_Horror.png and File:SuckerPunch.jpg [Observed] and the wiki's 'rock monster-like Riggs... cracked fragments of team coloured rock' [Fan-wiki]. The JustNubz Playtest #4 thumbnail (https://i.ytimg.com/vi/-lAtv-j9Sms/maxresdefault.jpg) shows the Heavy in 'THE INCREDIBLE RIGGS' skin (green Hulk-style, torn maroon trousers) on build string '3.0.5_2026.11.19_B1' [Observed]. That video was not watched.

ERA EQUIVALENTS:
- BB-1 (2010): Machine Gun (M249-like default), Laser and Chainsaw [Fan-wiki]. Riggs jams a green Huggable's head into a dead laser gun, which fires a green piercing laser that reflects in Hyper mode [Fan-wiki]. The cutscene frame in File:Laser.png shows a green beam from a gun topped by a green Huggable head [Observed].
- BBF (2013): Minigun ("Takes a little bit to get going but once it gets going its damage is unrivaled!" [Game text via wiki]) and Dual Lasers [Fan-wiki].
- BBO/BBU (2015-16): Minigun variants (Standard, Steampunk, Futuristic, Goo), Electric Honey (BBO) and the 'Two-Hand Salute' red-fist ability [Fan-wiki]. File:Image-1.jpeg shows the BBO Electric Honey as an orange-and-black minigun with coiled orange tubes and a flared muzzle [Observed]; it is a different design from the BBG version.
- BBH (2023 soft launch, 2024): attack 'Beebee Gun', Ultimate 'He can fly now?' [Fan-wiki]. SkyVu: "Riggs's Ultimate showcases his astonishing leap and ground-smashing ability, disrupting enemies and terrain alike." [Canon]. Riggs's Ultimate was reworked in 1.0.27 (Jun 20 2023), and his base damage cut 400 to 360 on Aug 29 2023 [Fan-wiki].
